title: Yaara
desc: A group of close friends who ran a ruthless criminal gang when they were young get separated due to several circumstances. When they reunite after many years, it is to help their friend in need.

title: Maqbool
desc: Maqbool, an underworld don's henchman, falls in love with his boss's mistress, Nimmi, who instigates him to kill the don and become the next leader.

desc: A police officer investigates a mysterious death in Mumbai, facing personal struggles and a broken marriage. A sex worker adds to the puzzle as he seeks the truth.

title: Mili
desc: Mili, a nursing graduate, wishes to relocate to Canada. However, unfathomable circumstances come to the fore as she inadvertently gets trapped in a freezer.

desc: Set in post-independence Mumbai, this gritty story follows the rise of the underworld as crime, power and survival shape the city's changing landscape.

title: Rehnaa Hai Terre Dil Mein
